mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_PROFILE (memberid, gender, birth, phone, country, address, height, weight, hobby, mbti, religion, drinking, smoking) VALUES (#{memberid}, #{gender}, #{birth}, #{phone}, #{country}, #{address}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{hobby}, #{mbti}, #{religion}, #{drinking}, #{smoking})
mapper.select: SELECT memberid, gender, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, phone, country, address, height, weight, hobby, mbti, religion, drinking, smoking FROM MEMBER_PROFILE WHERE memberid = #{memberid}
